package xxhash

// Sum64String computes the 64-bit xxHash digest of s.
func ( string) uint64 {
	return Sum64([]byte())
}

// WriteString adds more data to d. It always returns len(s), nil.
func ( *Digest) ( string) ( int,  error) {
	return .Write([]byte())
}
